mostWorthwhile.text: Making an animal painting from memory was satisfying: it turned an absent animal into an image others could recognize.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing pigment in the cave was a straightforward preparation, but less interesting than making or using it.

surprise.text: The call's echo became a song through remembering and repeating sounds in a chosen rhythm; that was an unexpected but plausible progression.

arbitrary.text: Adding stars fulfilled the painting goal, but their placement around the animal had no clear purpose beyond completing the image.

continue.text: Yes. The progression from cave acoustics to song and from discovery to teaching makes me curious about what the community might create next, though the compatible-option menu made the choices fairly straightforward.
